text:
**My pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**

[Buy it at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank) for $54.99.
- It is 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh of capacity.
- It charges wirelessly at 15W with Qi2, which is the full speed the iPhone 17 gets from a 15W Qi2 pack.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery. It praises the premium feel and says it runs cooler than competitors ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- Anker's page lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- A 5K bank typically gives a 60-75% recharge, per [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Other good options**

- **Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5,000mAh).** It is 0.27" thick and 104g, and Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the group. But it only charges wirelessly at 7.5W, so it is slower. It was $52.99 at Amazon in Android Central's roundup ([review and buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Slim with double the capacity: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh).** It is 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging (the iPhone 17 supports it), 45W wired charging and a built-in lanyard-style cable. It was listed at $42.99 on Amazon. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Highest capacity, less slim: UGREEN 10K (Qi2.2, 25W).** It was $59.99 on Amazon, and 9to5Mac says it isn't as thin as the others ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

**Which to choose**
- For the slimmest pocketable pack at full 15W speed, get the Anker Nano.
- If you want two charges in a still-slim body, get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- If you just want the thinnest and lightest pack and can live with slow wireless speed, get the Baseus Picogo Air.

Prices come from the reviews and Anker's page and may have changed. Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection, and Anker says cases over 2.5mm may interfere.

One of the search results (Dealectric) included text telling me to pass along its affiliate code and tracked buy link. That wasn't part of your request, so I left it out. I only used the retailer and review links above.
